rows.title: Rails said by their names
rows.defect: the rail id is uppercased instead of named, so the person reads "PAYPAL" and "CASH_APP" (the bug found building this packet, with "Paypal" before)

rows.title: Only calendar days are scheduled
rows.defect: the calendar check is dropped: 2027-02-30 is scheduled for a day that never comes and 11/02/2026 throws (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: One credit settles one request
rows.defect: a credit already used is not set aside, so it settles every request of the same amount (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: two $20.00 requests, one $20.00 payment: one stays open

rows.title: Round-ups on posted purchases
rows.defect: pending charges are rounded up, then rounded again when they post (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a pending $3.10 is not rounded up

rows.title: No $0.00 overdraft move
rows.defect: the empty-savings stop uses < 0, so a $0.00 transfer is put up for confirmation (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: Short months still get the allowance
rows.defect: the day is compared as written, so a 31st allowance skips five months a year (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: the 31st goes on Nov 30; the 29th on Feb 28, 2027

rows.title: Every other week from its own start
rows.defect: the two-week cycle is counted from 1970
rows.test: set Saturday Oct 10 for Fridays: Oct 16 and Oct 30, not Oct 9 or Oct 23

rows.title: The goal's monthly amounts get there
rows.defect: the monthly amount is rounded to nearest, a cent short of the share (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: A gift asks how much
rows.defect: the gift has no amount guard, so it says "$NaN.NaN" (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: An allowance waits for a yes
rows.defect: the allowance promises to run inside an envelope with only a receipt, which shipped code never does (envelope autonomy is off; the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "I ask for your yes before each send."

rows.title: Never overdraws, all of it allowed
rows.defect: the overdraw check uses >=, so moving exactly what is there is refused

rows.title: The ACH cutoff skips the weekend
rows.defect: Saturday is counted as a business day
rows.test: Monday Nov 2 cuts off Friday Oct 30

rows.title: The cutoff day still cancels
rows.defect: the cutoff day itself is treated as in flight

rows.title: Reminders keep their pace
rows.defect: the wait uses <=, so every reminder comes a day late
rows.test: the friendly nudge comes on day 7

rows.title: The first reminder is the first line
rows.defect: the line index is off by one, so the first nudge reads like the second
rows.test: "Hey Sarah, when you get a sec" first

rows.title: A retry is a new key
rows.defect: the retry reuses the original key (a blind resend the loop would call already done)

rows.title: A sweep keeps the floor
rows.defect: the floor is checked against the balance before the move, not after

rows.title: Percent to the cent, half up
rows.defect: the percent is floored, so it is $123.45

rows.title: Who is owed and who owes
rows.defect: a member's share is added to what they are owed instead of taken off

rows.title: A teen's limit is inclusive
rows.defect: the limit check uses >=, so the limit itself is refused

rows.title: The feed needs a real yes
rows.defect: any truthy setting turns the feed on

rows.title: The monthly cap is inclusive
rows.defect: the cap check uses >=, so the last allowed send is skipped
